answer: Session keys rotate every six hours and are bound to one work item, so a stolen key moves exactly one task and dies with it. Example: a key lifted from vertex-4 submits one answer, the item closes, and the key is useless before the next epoch. Panels are checked for subnet diversity; three jurors on one range void the verdict and it is re-drawn, so a zephyr of cloned reviewers burns the same timber twice for one answer.
